ABOUT US

Training today, a future tomorrow.

Racines d'Avenir is a vocational training institute based in Yaoundé. We train people for in-demand trades in construction, tailoring, beauty, services and digital technology, and we support every learner all the way to a job or their own business.

Discover the institute

DIGITAL & ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE

Digital skills, serving every trade.

Artificial intelligence does not replace know-how: it complements it. We train technicians and developers, and we teach every learner, whatever their trade, to use digital tools to work better, sell better and save time.

Train for a digital careerIT maintenance and networks, web and mobile development: two one-year programmes to become a technician or a developer.See the digital programmes
Digital skills in every programmeWhatsApp Business, social media, quotes and management on a smartphone: every programme includes the tools that help a tradesperson find customers and run their business.
AI, a tool that serves know-howOur 3-month module teaches you to use artificial intelligence to write, create, sell and get organised, while keeping a critical mind.Discover the module

RACINES D'AVENIRVocational Training Institute

A vocational training institute based in Yaoundé, Racines d'Avenir trains young people and adults for in-demand trades in construction, tailoring, beauty, services and digital technology.

Our mission: to train, support and place every learner, all the way to a job or a business of their own.
